Class Base45.Builder

java.lang.Object
org.apache.commons.codec.binary.BaseNCodec.AbstractBuilder<Base45, Base45.Builder>
org.apache.commons.codec.binary.Base45.Builder
All Implemented Interfaces:
Supplier<Base45>
Enclosing class:
Base45
public static class Base45.Builder extends BaseNCodec.AbstractBuilder<Base45, Base45.Builder>
Builds Base45 instances.

To configure a new instance, use a Base45.Builder. For example: 


Base45 base45 = Base45.builder().get();
Since:
1.23.0

    • setDecodingPolicy

      public Base45.Builder setDecodingPolicy(CodecPolicy decodingPolicy)
      Sets the decoding policy. CodecPolicy.STRICT is the only supported policy.
      Overrides:
      setDecodingPolicy in class BaseNCodec.AbstractBuilder<Base45, Base45.Builder>
      Parameters:
      decodingPolicy - The decoding policy; null resets to the default (CodecPolicy.STRICT).
      Returns:
      this instance.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - Thrown if the given policy is CodecPolicy.LENIENT.

    • setEncodeTable

      public Base45.Builder setEncodeTable(byte... encodeTable)
      Sets the encode table and derives the matching decode table, so the codec can always decode its own output.
      Overrides:
      setEncodeTable in class BaseNCodec.AbstractBuilder<Base45, Base45.Builder>
      Parameters:
      encodeTable - The encode table with exactly 45 unique entries, null resets to the default.
      Returns:
      this instance.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - Thrown if the encode table does not contain exactly 45 unique entries.

    • setLineLength

      public Base45.Builder setLineLength(int lineLength)

      Overrides:
      setLineLength in class BaseNCodec.AbstractBuilder<Base45, Base45.Builder>
      Parameters:

      Returns:
      this instance.

      UnsupportedOperationException - Thrown because Base45 RFC 9285 does not support this operation.
